meta.title: Set default sorting by duration
meta.body_summary: Simplify task ordering in terminal-bench by defaulting to duration-based descending sort, removing the --order-by-duration CLI option, and integrating sorting directly into the Dataset class.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor simplified task ordering with default duration sort; merged after maintainer approval without review comments; no performance benchmark provided.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2828 changed lines (inflated by a merge commit bringing in many task files), the core sorting change is modest (~300 lines). This fits a small-step, low-risk refactor and is consistent with a successful merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No substantive review text; maintainer approved without comments.
review_details.performance_claim: Sorting tasks by duration (longest first) enables optimal concurrent execution by running longer tasks earlier.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Orchestration-level change in Python harness; straightforward refactor with minimal review friction and no performance evidence required.

detection_detail.code_reading: TheMikeMerrill reviewed and approved without inline comments; likely reviewed code logic and simplicity.

core_change_summary.description: Removed TrialSorter class and SortingMethod enum; added sort_by_duration() method in Dataset class that loads task durations from YAML and sorts tasks descending; Harness explicitly calls dataset.sort_by_duration() after dataset initialization; removed --order-by-duration CLI option; improved logging with tabulate; updated imports accordingly.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The large merge commit (803e21b) brought in numerous unrelated task additions and modifications, inflating total change lines.
change_trajectory: Initial refactor with TrialSorter and SortingMethod classes.

Removed trial_sorter and integrated duration sorting directly into Dataset.
